name: Forged & Sent Weekly Challenges
source: Google Sheet: Forged and Sent Weekly Challenges

assumptions.note: Veterans Day lands in Week 2 and Memorial Day in Week 31 when Week 1 starts Monday Nov 2 2026. Move holiday weeks if the start date changes.

slots.label: Family
slots.description: Something the man does for his family that is centered on faith. Completion only; not ranked.

slots.label: Iron
slots.description: Rep, hold or quantity event that builds strength. Ranked. Named for Proverbs 27:17.

slots.label: Endure
slots.description: Distance, time or round event that builds the engine. Ranked. Named for Hebrews 12:1.

scoredByTypes.most_reps: Most reps in the set or window wins
scoredByTypes.greatest_distance: Farthest distance in the fixed time wins; ranked within the mode chosen
scoredByTypes.most_rounds: Most completed rounds wins; extra reps break ties
scoredByTypes.highest_total: Highest combined score across stations wins

scoring.targetMeaning: Fixed-work events: the work to finish. Most reps, longest hold, greatest distance, most rounds and highest total events: the minimum result needed to qualify.

seasons.name: Be Watchful
seasons.theme: Pay attention; guard what matters; build the daily habits of a man who is present.
seasons.familyFocus: Prayer; presence at the table; knowing and blessing your wife and kids; guarding the home.
seasons.physicalFocus: Build the base: modest bodyweight volume; first benchmark tests; easy cardio and short rucks. Veterans Day week themed in Week 2.

seasons.name: Stand Firm
seasons.theme: Hold your ground in your convictions; set boundaries; stand beside your wife.
seasons.familyFocus: Family mission; boundaries; Scripture memory; serving together; covenant with your wife.
seasons.physicalFocus: Gradual increase: first strength tests; longer jogs and rucks; short intervals.

seasons.name: Act Like Men
seasons.theme: Take initiative; lead by serving; carry responsibility.
seasons.familyFocus: Leading prayer; household initiative; blessing your kids; generosity; discipling another man.
seasons.physicalFocus: Moderate volume; heavy carries; sprints; longer endurance days. Memorial Day week themed in Week 31.

seasons.name: Be Strong
seasons.anchorScripture: 1 Corinthians 16:13-14 (be strong; do everything in love) and Matthew 28:18-20
seasons.theme: Strength under love; finish the year strong and get sent out on mission.
seasons.familyFocus: Love shown daily; speaking life; going and inviting; Sabbath; commissioning your family.
seasons.physicalFocus: Retests against earlier benchmarks; steady volume; year-end ruck on Week 52.
